attempts.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.22.10) as the internal chrony time source for the cluster (allow 10.100.22.0/24, local stratum 10 fallback, NTP opened in firewalld) and node2 (10.100.22.11) to sync exclusively against node1 (server 10.100.22.10 iburst prefer, public pool servers removed). Verified sync in both directions, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes with boot-id proof and post-restart recovery verification.
